notes.title: Now Available in VR!
notes.notes: StarBall is now available in VR!  Put on your headset and immerse yourself in the zero-gravity sport of tomorrow.  Single-player and online modes available, including VR-desktop crossplay.

notes.title: Live: The Physics of StarBall
notes.notes: 2-on-2 basketball in zero-gravity sounds simple enough, but turning a physics simulation into an entertaining game requires the rules to be broken in subtle but interesting ways.  In this stream, we will discuss how and why the physics of StarBall differs from the physics of real life.  Get under the hood and learn about how games are coded and the decisions that must be made when designing physical interactions.

notes.title: Live: Face the Developers
notes.notes:
Meet the developers of StarBall.  Play a game or just chat.

The StarBall demo will be available during the Steam Game Festival.  Take a look during this live stream event for an opportunity to play with (or against!) the game's creators.  We are eager for the chance to share our game with you.
